title: Add 2026-02-01 API version for RecoveryServices and RecoveryServicesBackup

artifactEvidence.autorest: Preserved base/head emitter runs succeeded for both projects; head adds stable 2026-02-01 OpenAPI artifacts without changing any previously emitted API version.
artifactEvidence.tcgc: Preserved base/head generic TCGC output adds 2026-02-01 and changes the default API version; independent base/head source comparison confirms four @@clientLocation scopes changed from !csharp to !csharp,!go.

items.intent: Add 2026 versions and preserve Go client placement
transformationChain: The service adds 2026-01-31-preview and 2026-02-01, propagating existing protected-item and recovery-point REST contracts into the stable version. Three @@clientLocation compatibility customizations also begin applying to Go, changing generated client ownership without changing wire behavior.

changes.summary: Add 2026 versions and preserve Go client placement

aspects.after: The 2026 preview and stable versions are declared and the three operations use explicit Go client locations.

findings.title: Generated SDK method moves between clients
findings.summary: Moving released Go methods between generated clients can break imports, client construction, and method calls while preserving the HTTP contract.
evidence: Expanding a clientLocation exclusion from C# to C# and Go can move existing Go methods between generated clients.

documents.title: Adding a Stable Version when the Last Version was Preview
documents.guidanceExcerpt: For any type with an `@added(p)` decorator, delete the type. Remove the replaced preview version from the version enum.
documents.applicableGuidance: The stable version retains the replaced preview member, and the client customizations are placed in back-compatible.tsp rather than the documented client.tsp file.
documents.evidence: The same version-enum change contains v2026_01_31_preview and v2026_02_01.
documents.expectedCodeReason: The bounded official document evidence did not contain an example block.

documents.title: Clients
documents.guidanceExcerpt: Customizations SHOULD always be made in a file named `client.tsp` alongside `main.tsp`.
documents.applicableGuidance: The stable version retains the replaced preview member, and the client customizations are placed in back-compatible.tsp rather than the documented client.tsp file.

findings.title: Replaced preview remains in the version enum
findings.summary: The version enum adds 2026-02-01 while retaining 2026-01-31-preview, contrary to the stable-after-preview guidance.
evidence: The same version-enum change contains v2026_01_31_preview and v2026_02_01.

findings.title: Client customizations are outside client.tsp
findings.summary: The new @@clientLocation customizations are in back-compatible.tsp instead of the documented client.tsp customization file.
